newsitem.title: USA: Time sells stake in Martha Stewart Living.
newsitem.headline: Time sells stake in Martha Stewart Living.

text.p: Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia LLC acquired Martha Stewart Living Enterprises from Time Inc, the two companies said Tuesday.
Time, a unit of Time Warner Inc, retains a minority interest, holding "less than 20 percent," Time spokesman Peter Costiglio told Reuters.

Martha Stewart, the chairman of Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia and an American symbol of haute cuisine and proper hosting, approached Time about a year ago seeking to acquire the unit that includes a monthly magazine, Martha Stewart Living.
"She wanted to have more control of her operations and the freedom to expand them more aggressively," Costiglio said.
"Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia, now a fully integrated company, is devoted to synergizing media and merchandising into a cohesive, understandable business," Martha Stewart said in a statement.
The company now includes a line of books, a syndicated newspaper column, a mail-order catalog company and a publishing and online division.
The magazine was begun in July 1991 by Time Publishing Ventures Inc, a unit of Time Inc.
